aiResearchSummary.text: VOID Technologies is engaged in developing polymeric compositions for manufacturing articles with internal cavities, as described in 'Polyolefin composition with ionomeric cavitation agent' and 'Olefin-Based Polymer Composition with Voiding Agent and Article.' These innovations involve a continuous polymeric phase, such as polyolefin, combined with dispersed cavitation or voiding agents, including ionomeric and functionalized styrene polymers. Their research focuses on advanced materials with engineered internal structures.
